# ATRIA-X Design System â€” Dark Theme Token Spec (v1)

Author: Hermes. Source of truth for the Figma variables I will create and for any later
code port. Extracted from the two v0.dev references (caregiver Progress Note wizard +
CareSync coordinator dashboard). Dark theme now; a light theme will be added later as a
second variable mode, so every token below is defined as a **semantic role**, not a raw
color, so we can swap modes without renaming anything.

How this maps to Figma: I create one variable collection "ATRIA" with a mode "Dark" (and
later "Light"). Groups: color/*, text/*, space/*, radius/*, size/*. Components bind to
these variables, never to raw hex.

---

## 1. Color â€” core surfaces (Dark mode)

| Token | Hex | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color/bg/base        | #0A0E0F | App background (near-black) |
| color/bg/sunken      | #070A0B | Behind cards, deepest layer |
| color/surface/1      | #11171A | Card background |
| color/surface/2      | #161D21 | Raised card / popover |
| color/surface/3      | #1C262B | Hover / input background |
| color/sidebar/bg     | #0C1113 | Left navigation |
| color/border/subtle  | #1F2A2F | Hairline dividers |
| color/border/default | #2A373D | Card & input borders |
| color/border/strong  | #3A4A52 | Focus ring base, emphasis |

## 2. Color â€” text

| Token | Hex | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color/text/primary   | #F2F6F7 | Headings, key values |
| color/text/secondary | #AEBCC2 | Body, labels |
| color/text/muted     | #6E808A | Hints, timestamps, captions |
| color/text/disabled  | #49575E | Disabled |
| color/text/onAccent  | #04140E | Text on green buttons |

## 3. Color â€” brand & accent (per-step theming from the wizard)

Primary action color across the product is emerald green (the "Next Step"/"Submit" pills).
The wizard themes each step with an accent; we keep those as named accents reused elsewhere.

| Token | Hex | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color/accent/primary      | #16A34A | Primary buttons, success, progress fill |
| color/accent/primaryHover | #15833D | Button hover |
| color/accent/primaryQuiet | rgba(22,163,74,0.14) | Selected tile bg, success chip bg |
| color/step/when (blue)    | #3B82F6 | Step 1 theme |
| color/step/what (purple)  | #A855F7 | Step 2 theme |
| color/step/how (amber)    | #F59E0B | Step 3 theme |
| color/step/goal (teal)    | #14B8A6 | Step 4 theme |
| color/step/issues (red)   | #EF4444 | Step 5 theme |
| color/step/done (green)   | #16A34A | Step 6 theme |

## 4. Color â€” status (semantic; word + color, never color alone)

| Token | Hex | Bg token | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| color/status/success | #2FBF71 | rgba(47,191,113,0.14)  | Compliant / Approved / Active |
| color/status/warning | #F0B429 | rgba(240,180,41,0.14)  | Warning / Due soon / Medium |
| color/status/danger  | #F0564A | rgba(240,86,74,0.14)   | Critical / Expired / High / Action Required |
| color/status/info    | #4D8DF6 | rgba(77,141,246,0.14)  | Submitted / Informational |
| color/status/neutral | #8A99A0 | rgba(138,153,160,0.12) | Scheduled / Low / default |

## 5. Typography (Inter; matches current repo --font-sans)

| Token | Size / Line / Weight | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| text/display | 28 / 34 / 700 | Page title ("Dashboard Overview") |
| text/h1      | 22 / 28 / 700 | Section / step title ("Step 1: When?") |
| text/h2      | 18 / 24 / 600 | Card titles |
| text/body    | 16 / 24 / 400 | Default body (â‰¥16 for low-tech users) |
| text/bodyMed | 16 / 24 / 600 | Emphasis / tile labels |
| text/small   | 14 / 20 / 400 | Secondary |
| text/caption | 12 / 16 / 500 | Badges, timestamps, counts |
| text/kpi     | 32 / 38 / 700 | KPI numbers ("156", "94.2%") |

Min base size is 16px on purpose (Atria's "really bad with technology" users).

## 6. Spacing (4pt base)

| Token | px |  | Token | px |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| space/1 | 4  | | space/5 | 24 |
| space/2 | 8  | | space/6 | 32 |
| space/3 | 12 | | space/8 | 48 |
| space/4 | 16 | | space/10 | 64 |

Default card padding = space/5 (24). Page gutters = space/6 (32) desktop, space/4 mobile.

## 7. Radius

| Token | px | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| radius/sm  | 8  | Inputs, badges |
| radius/md  | 12 | Buttons |
| radius/lg  | 16 | Cards, tiles |
| radius/xl  | 20 | Wizard step panels |
| radius/pill | 999 | Pill buttons, progress bar |

## 8. Sizing / touch targets

| Token | px | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| size/control/md | 40 | Standard input/button height |
| size/control/lg | 52 | Primary wizard buttons / mobile (â‰¥44 min) |
| size/tile       | 88 | Service/Goal tap tiles (big touch target) |
| size/sidebar    | 248 | Left nav width (desktop) |
| size/topbar     | 64 | Top bar height |
| size/kpiCard    | 140 | KPI card min height |
| size/avatar     | 36 | List avatars |

## 9. Elevation / effects
- shadow/card: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)
- shadow/pop: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)
- focus ring: 2px color/accent/primary at 60% + 2px offset
- Selected tile: 1.5px color/accent/primary border + color/accent/primaryQuiet fill + check icon.

## 10. Component inventory (built from the tokens above)
Button (variants: primary, secondary, ghost, danger; sizes md, lg) Â· IconButton Â·
Card / CardHeader / CardTitle / CardContent Â· KpiCard (label, value, deltaÂ±, icon) Â·
StatusPill (success/warning/danger/info/neutral) Â· CountBadge Â· Input Â· Select Â· Textarea
(+ char count + inline "Looking good!" validation row) Â· FieldGroup (label + helper + error)
Â· Checkbox Â· RadioCard (the "No, everything was fine" big option rows) Â· Tabs Â· Table Â·
Dialog Â· Toast Â· Avatar Â· ProgressBar (top of wizard) Â· StepRail + StepChip (emoji/icon,
active/complete/upcoming) Â· BottomProgressTracker Â· ServiceTile / GoalTile (emoji + label,
selectable) Â· AlertRow (icon, title, "Action Required" pill, timestamp) Â· ComplianceRow
(avatar, name, status pill, progress, x/8) Â· CategoryBar (label, count, % bar) Â· Sidebar +
NavItem (icon, label, count badge, section header) Â· Topbar (search, Quick Actions,
notifications, env pill, user) Â· EmptyState Â· LoadingState Â· ErrorState Â· PermissionDenied.

## 11. Light mode (later)
When we add Light: keep every token name, add a "Light" mode to the ATRIA collection.
Likely values reuse the current repo's light palette (bg #f4f7f8, surface #fff, ink
#17212b, accent #0f766e, borders #d9e3e7). Status/step accents stay the same hues, darkened
for contrast on light. No component rework needed â€” only the mode values change.

import { cn } from '@/shared/lib/cn'

interface EmptyStateProps {
  icon?: ReactNode
  title: string
  description?: string
  action?: ReactNode
  className?: string
}

export function EmptyState({
  icon,
  title,
  description,
  action,
  className,
}: EmptyStateProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        'flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-[var(--radius-atria-lg)] border border-dashed border-atria-border bg-atria-surface p-8 text-center',

      )}
    >
      {icon && (
        <div className="mb-4 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-atria-surface-2 text-atria-text-secondary">

      )}
      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-atria-ink">{title}</h3>

        <p className="mt-1 max-w-sm text-base text-atria-text-secondary">

}

import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/shared/lib/cn'

export type ToastVariant = 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'info' | 'neutral'

interface ToastProps {
  variant?: ToastVariant
  title: string
  description?: string
  action?: ReactNode
  onClose?: () => void
  className?: string
}

const toastStyles: Record<ToastVariant, string> = {
  success:
    'border-atria-success/30 bg-atria-success-bg text-atria-success',
  warning:
    'border-atria-warning/30 bg-atria-warning-bg text-atria-warning',
  danger:
    'border-atria-danger/30 bg-atria-danger-bg text-atria-danger',
  info:
    'border-atria-info/30 bg-atria-info-bg text-atria-info',
  neutral:
    'border-atria-border-strong bg-atria-neutral-bg text-atria-neutral',
}

export function Toast({
  variant = 'neutral',
  title,
  description,
  action,
  onClose,
  className,
}: ToastProps) {
  return (
    <div
      role="status"
      className={cn(
        'flex w-full max-w-sm items-start gap-3 rounded-[var(--radius-atria-lg)] border p-4 shadow-[var(--shadow-atria-pop)]',
        toastStyles[variant],
        className,
      )}
    >
      <div className="flex-1">
        <p className="text-base font-semibold">{title}</p>
        {description && (
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm opacity-90">{description}</p>
        )}
        {action && <div className="mt-3">{action}</div>}
      </div>
      {onClose && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-black/10"
          aria-label="Close notification"

import { type PropsWithChildren, type ReactNode, type ReactElement, isValidElement, cloneElement } from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/shared/lib/cn'

interface FieldGroupProps {
  label: ReactNode
  htmlFor?: string
  helperText?: ReactNode
  error?: ReactNode
  required?: boolean
  className?: string
}

export function FieldGroup({
  label,
  htmlFor,
  helperText,
  error,
  required,
  className,
  children,
}: PropsWithChildren<FieldGroupProps>) {
  const helperId = helperText ? `${htmlFor}-helper` : undefined
  const errorId = error ? `${htmlFor}-error` : undefined
  const describedBy = [helperId, errorId].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || undefined

  const input = isValidElement(children)
    ? cloneElement(
        children as ReactElement<{ 'aria-describedby'?: string; 'aria-invalid'?: boolean }>,
        {
          'aria-describedby': describedBy,
          'aria-invalid': error ? true : undefined,
        },
      )
    : children

  return (
    <div className={cn('flex flex-col gap-1.5', className)}>
      <label
        htmlFor={htmlFor}
        className="text-base font-medium text-atria-ink"
      >
        {label}
        {required && <span className="ml-1 text-atria-danger">*</span>}
      </label>
      {input}
      {helperText && !error && (
        <span id={helperId} className="text-sm text-atria-text-secondary">
          {helperText}
        </span>
      )}
      {error && (
        <span id={errorId} className="text-sm text-atria-danger">
          {error}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

import { cn } from '@/shared/lib/cn'

export type ProgressStep = {
  id: string
  label: string
  description?: string
  accentClass?: string
}

type StepAccent = {
  text: string
  border: string
  bg: string
  connector: string
}

const defaultAccent: StepAccent = {
  text: 'text-atria-accent',
  border: 'border-atria-accent',
  bg: 'bg-atria-accent',
  connector: 'bg-atria-accent',
}

const stepAccentMap: Record<string, StepAccent> = {
  when: {
    text: 'text-atria-step-when',
    border: 'border-atria-step-when',
    bg: 'bg-atria-step-when',
    connector: 'bg-atria-step-when',
  },
  what: {
    text: 'text-atria-step-what',
    border: 'border-atria-step-what',
    bg: 'bg-atria-step-what',
    connector: 'bg-atria-step-what',
  },
  how: {
    text: 'text-atria-step-how',
    border: 'border-atria-step-how',
    bg: 'bg-atria-step-how',
    connector: 'bg-atria-step-how',
  },
  goal: {
    text: 'text-atria-step-goal',
    border: 'border-atria-step-goal',
    bg: 'bg-atria-step-goal',
    connector: 'bg-atria-step-goal',
  },
  issues: {
    text: 'text-atria-step-issues',
    border: 'border-atria-step-issues',
    bg: 'bg-atria-step-issues',
    connector: 'bg-atria-step-issues',
  },
  done: {
    text: 'text-atria-step-done',
    border: 'border-atria-step-done',
    bg: 'bg-atria-step-done',
    connector: 'bg-atria-step-done',
  },
}

function accentFor(stepId: string): StepAccent {
  return stepAccentMap[stepId] ?? defaultAccent
}

interface ProgressStepsProps {
  steps: ProgressStep[]
  currentStep: number
  className?: string
}

export function ProgressSteps({ steps, currentStep, className }: ProgressStepsProps) {
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Progress" className={cn('w-full', className)}>
      <ol className="flex items-start gap-2">
        {steps.map((step, index) => {
          const isComplete = index < currentStep
          const isActive = index === currentStep
          const isUpcoming = index > currentStep
          const accent = accentFor(step.id)
          const activeTextClass = step.accentClass ?? accent.text

          return (
            <li
              key={step.id}
              className="relative flex flex-1 flex-col items-center text-center"
              aria-current={isActive ? 'step' : undefined}
            >
              <div className="flex w-full items-center">
                {index > 0 && (
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      'hidden sm:block flex-1 h-0.5 -mr-2',
                      isComplete ? accent.connector : 'bg-atria-border',
                    )}
                  />
                )}
                <div
                  className={cn(
                    'z-10 flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 text-sm font-semibold',
                    isComplete && `${accent.border} ${accent.bg} text-white`,
                    isActive && `${accent.border} bg-atria-accent-quiet ${activeTextClass}`,
                    isUpcoming && 'border-atria-border bg-atria-surface text-atria-text-muted',
                  )}
                >
                  {isComplete ? (
                    <svg
                      className="h-5 w-5"
                      fill="none"
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      strokeWidth={3}
                    >
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
                    </svg>
                  ) : (
                    <span>{index + 1}</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                {index < steps.length - 1 && (
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      'hidden sm:block flex-1 h-0.5 -ml-2',
                      isComplete ? accent.connector : 'bg-atria-border',
                    )}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 px-1">
                <p
                  className={cn(
                    'text-sm font-medium',
                    isUpcoming ? 'text-atria-text-muted' : 'text-atria-ink',
                  )}
                >
                  {step.label}
                </p>
                {step.description && (
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-atria-text-secondary">
                    {step.description}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            </li>
          )
        })}
      </ol>
    </nav>
  )
}

.hermes-pipeline/20260624_162530\fix_iter1.prompt.md:7:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). .hermes-pipeline/20260624_162530\fix_iter1.prompt.md:1062:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.

.hermes-pipeline/20260624_162530\review_codex_iter1.md:89:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. .hermes-pipeline/20260624_162530\review_codex_iter1.md:996:ATRIA-X: multi-tenant SaaS for home-care agencies. React19+Vite8+TS, Tailwind4, React Router 7, Clerk (auth/orgs), Convex (backend+DB), Vitest, Playwright. Formatting: 2-space indent, single quotes, NO semicolons, PascalCase components, camelCase utils. CORE RULE: a service is never billed unless its shift documentation is complete and approved (caregiver->coordinator->billing). Multi-tenancy is the central invariant: every Convex fn touching tenant data MUST go through authHelpers.ts guards (requireTenant / requireTenantRole / assertTenantDoc); enforce auth twice (RouteGuard + server). Roles: org:admin, org:coordinator, org:caregiver. After editing convex/* run `npx convex codegen`. Never edit convex/_generated by hand. Follow CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.

# ATRIA-X Design System Ã¢â‚¬â€ Dark Theme Token Spec (v1)

Author: Hermes. Source of truth for the Figma variables I will create and for any later
code port. Extracted from the two v0.dev references (caregiver Progress Note wizard +
CareSync coordinator dashboard). Dark theme now; a light theme will be added later as a
second variable mode, so every token below is defined as a **semantic role**, not a raw
color, so we can swap modes without renaming anything.

How this maps to Figma: I create one variable collection "ATRIA" with a mode "Dark" (and
later "Light"). Groups: color/*, text/*, space/*, radius/*, size/*. Components bind to
these variables, never to raw hex.

---

## 1. Color Ã¢â‚¬â€ core surfaces (Dark mode)

| Token | Hex | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color/bg/base        | #0A0E0F | App background (near-black) |
| color/bg/sunken      | #070A0B | Behind cards, deepest layer |
| color/surface/1      | #11171A | Card background |
| color/surface/2      | #161D21 | Raised card / popover |
| color/surface/3      | #1C262B | Hover / input background |
| color/sidebar/bg     | #0C1113 | Left navigation |
| color/border/subtle  | #1F2A2F | Hairline dividers |
| color/border/default | #2A373D | Card & input borders |
| color/border/strong  | #3A4A52 | Focus ring base, emphasis |

## 2. Color Ã¢â‚¬â€ text

| Token | Hex | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color/text/primary   | #F2F6F7 | Headings, key values |
| color/text/secondary | #AEBCC2 | Body, labels |
| color/text/muted     | #6E808A | Hints, timestamps, captions |
| color/text/disabled  | #49575E | Disabled |
| color/text/onAccent  | #04140E | Text on green buttons |

## 3. Color Ã¢â‚¬â€ brand & accent (per-step theming from the wizard)

Primary action color across the product is emerald green (the "Next Step"/"Submit" pills).
The wizard themes each step with an accent; we keep those as named accents reused elsewhere.

| Token | Hex | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color/accent/primary      | #16A34A | Primary buttons, success, progress fill |
| color/accent/primaryHover | #15833D | Button hover |
| color/accent/primaryQuiet | rgba(22,163,74,0.14) | Selected tile bg, success chip bg |
| color/step/when (blue)    | #3B82F6 | Step 1 theme |
| color/step/what (purple)  | #A855F7 | Step 2 theme |
| color/step/how (amber)    | #F59E0B | Step 3 theme |
| color/step/goal (teal)    | #14B8A6 | Step 4 theme |
| color/step/issues (red)   | #EF4444 | Step 5 theme |
| color/step/done (green)   | #16A34A | Step 6 theme |

## 4. Color Ã¢â‚¬â€ status (semantic; word + color, never color alone)

| Token | Hex | Bg token | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| color/status/success | #2FBF71 | rgba(47,191,113,0.14)  | Compliant / Approved / Active |
| color/status/warning | #F0B429 | rgba(240,180,41,0.14)  | Warning / Due soon / Medium |
| color/status/danger  | #F0564A | rgba(240,86,74,0.14)   | Critical / Expired / High / Action Required |
| color/status/info    | #4D8DF6 | rgba(77,141,246,0.14)  | Submitted / Informational |
| color/status/neutral | #8A99A0 | rgba(138,153,160,0.12) | Scheduled / Low / default |

## 5. Typography (Inter; matches current repo --font-sans)

| Token | Size / Line / Weight | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| text/display | 28 / 34 / 700 | Page title ("Dashboard Overview") |
| text/h1      | 22 / 28 / 700 | Section / step title ("Step 1: When?") |
| text/h2      | 18 / 24 / 600 | Card titles |
| text/body    | 16 / 24 / 400 | Default body (Ã¢â€°Â¥16 for low-tech users) |
| text/bodyMed | 16 / 24 / 600 | Emphasis / tile labels |
| text/small   | 14 / 20 / 400 | Secondary |
| text/caption | 12 / 16 / 500 | Badges, timestamps, counts |
| text/kpi     | 32 / 38 / 700 | KPI numbers ("156", "94.2%") |

Min base size is 16px on purpose (Atria's "really bad with technology" users).

## 6. Spacing (4pt base)

| Token | px |  | Token | px |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| space/1 | 4  | | space/5 | 24 |
| space/2 | 8  | | space/6 | 32 |
| space/3 | 12 | | space/8 | 48 |
| space/4 | 16 | | space/10 | 64 |

Default card padding = space/5 (24). Page gutters = space/6 (32) desktop, space/4 mobile.

## 7. Radius

| Token | px | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| radius/sm  | 8  | Inputs, badges |
| radius/md  | 12 | Buttons |
| radius/lg  | 16 | Cards, tiles |
| radius/xl  | 20 | Wizard step panels |
| radius/pill | 999 | Pill buttons, progress bar |

## 8. Sizing / touch targets

| Token | px | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| size/control/md | 40 | Standard input/button height |
| size/control/lg | 52 | Primary wizard buttons / mobile (Ã¢â€°Â¥44 min) |
| size/tile       | 88 | Service/Goal tap tiles (big touch target) |
| size/sidebar    | 248 | Left nav width (desktop) |
| size/topbar     | 64 | Top bar height |
| size/kpiCard    | 140 | KPI card min height |
| size/avatar     | 36 | List avatars |

## 9. Elevation / effects
- shadow/card: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)
- shadow/pop: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)
- focus ring: 2px color/accent/primary at 60% + 2px offset
- Selected tile: 1.5px color/accent/primary border + color/accent/primaryQuiet fill + check icon.

## 10. Component inventory (built from the tokens above)
Button (variants: primary, secondary, ghost, danger; sizes md, lg) Ã‚Â· IconButton Ã‚Â·
Card / CardHeader / CardTitle / CardContent Ã‚Â· KpiCard (label, value, deltaÃ‚Â±, icon) Ã‚Â·
StatusPill (success/warning/danger/info/neutral) Ã‚Â· CountBadge Ã‚Â· Input Ã‚Â· Select Ã‚Â· Textarea
(+ char count + inline "Looking good!" validation row) Ã‚Â· FieldGroup (label + helper + error)
Ã‚Â· Checkbox Ã‚Â· RadioCard (the "No, everything was fine" big option rows) Ã‚Â· Tabs Ã‚Â· Table Ã‚Â·
Dialog Ã‚Â· Toast Ã‚Â· Avatar Ã‚Â· ProgressBar (top of wizard) Ã‚Â· StepRail + StepChip (emoji/icon,
active/complete/upcoming) Ã‚Â· BottomProgressTracker Ã‚Â· ServiceTile / GoalTile (emoji + label,
selectable) Ã‚Â· AlertRow (icon, title, "Action Required" pill, timestamp) Ã‚Â· ComplianceRow
(avatar, name, status pill, progress, x/8) Ã‚Â· CategoryBar (label, count, % bar) Ã‚Â· Sidebar +
NavItem (icon, label, count badge, section header) Ã‚Â· Topbar (search, Quick Actions,
notifications, env pill, user) Ã‚Â· EmptyState Ã‚Â· LoadingState Ã‚Â· ErrorState Ã‚Â· PermissionDenied.

## 11. Light mode (later)
When we add Light: keep every token name, add a "Light" mode to the ATRIA collection.
Likely values reuse the current repo's light palette (bg #f4f7f8, surface #fff, ink
#17212b, accent #0f766e, borders #d9e3e7). Status/step accents stay the same hues, darkened
for contrast on light. No component rework needed Ã¢â‚¬â€ only the mode values change.

@import "tailwindcss";

@theme inline {

  --color-atria-surface: #ffffff;

  --color-atria-ink: #17212b;
  --color-atria-muted: #667085;
  --color-atria-border: #d9e3e7;
  --color-atria-accent: #0f766e;
  --color-atria-accent-hover: #115e59;
  --color-atria-success: #16834f;
  --color-atria-success-bg: rgba(22, 131, 79, 0.1);
  --color-atria-warning: #b7791f;
  --color-atria-warning-bg: rgba(183, 121, 31, 0.12);
  --color-atria-danger: #b42318;
  --color-atria-danger-bg: rgba(180, 35, 24, 0.1);
  --color-atria-info: #2563eb;
  --color-atria-info-bg: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.1);
  --color-atria-sidebar-text: #b9c5cb;
  --color-atria-sidebar-active: #ffffff;
  --radius-atria: 8px;
}

:root {
  color: var(--color-atria-ink);
  background: var(--color-atria-bg);

}

}

button,
input,
textarea,
select {

}

  text-decoration: none;
}

}

# ATRIA-X Design System Ã¢â‚¬â€ Dark Theme Token Spec (v1)

Author: Hermes. Source of truth for the Figma variables I will create and for any later
code port. Extracted from the two v0.dev references (caregiver Progress Note wizard +
CareSync coordinator dashboard). Dark theme now; a light theme will be added later as a
second variable mode, so every token below is defined as a **semantic role**, not a raw
color, so we can swap modes without renaming anything.

How this maps to Figma: I create one variable collection "ATRIA" with a mode "Dark" (and
later "Light"). Groups: color/*, text/*, space/*, radius/*, size/*. Components bind to
these variables, never to raw hex.

---

## 1. Color Ã¢â‚¬â€ core surfaces (Dark mode)

| Token | Hex | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color/bg/base        | #0A0E0F | App background (near-black) |
| color/bg/sunken      | #070A0B | Behind cards, deepest layer |
| color/surface/1      | #11171A | Card background |
| color/surface/2      | #161D21 | Raised card / popover |
| color/surface/3      | #1C262B | Hover / input background |
| color/sidebar/bg     | #0C1113 | Left navigation |
| color/border/subtle  | #1F2A2F | Hairline dividers |
| color/border/default | #2A373D | Card & input borders |
| color/border/strong  | #3A4A52 | Focus ring base, emphasis |

## 2. Color Ã¢â‚¬â€ text

| Token | Hex | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color/text/primary   | #F2F6F7 | Headings, key values |
| color/text/secondary | #AEBCC2 | Body, labels |
| color/text/muted     | #6E808A | Hints, timestamps, captions |
| color/text/disabled  | #49575E | Disabled |
| color/text/onAccent  | #04140E | Text on green buttons |

## 3. Color Ã¢â‚¬â€ brand & accent (per-step theming from the wizard)

Primary action color across the product is emerald green (the "Next Step"/"Submit" pills).
The wizard themes each step with an accent; we keep those as named accents reused elsewhere.

| Token | Hex | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| color/accent/primary      | #16A34A | Primary buttons, success, progress fill |
| color/accent/primaryHover | #15833D | Button hover |
| color/accent/primaryQuiet | rgba(22,163,74,0.14) | Selected tile bg, success chip bg |
| color/step/when (blue)    | #3B82F6 | Step 1 theme |
| color/step/what (purple)  | #A855F7 | Step 2 theme |
| color/step/how (amber)    | #F59E0B | Step 3 theme |
| color/step/goal (teal)    | #14B8A6 | Step 4 theme |
| color/step/issues (red)   | #EF4444 | Step 5 theme |
| color/step/done (green)   | #16A34A | Step 6 theme |

## 4. Color Ã¢â‚¬â€ status (semantic; word + color, never color alone)

| Token | Hex | Bg token | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| color/status/success | #2FBF71 | rgba(47,191,113,0.14)  | Compliant / Approved / Active |
| color/status/warning | #F0B429 | rgba(240,180,41,0.14)  | Warning / Due soon / Medium |
| color/status/danger  | #F0564A | rgba(240,86,74,0.14)   | Critical / Expired / High / Action Required |
| color/status/info    | #4D8DF6 | rgba(77,141,246,0.14)  | Submitted / Informational |
| color/status/neutral | #8A99A0 | rgba(138,153,160,0.12) | Scheduled / Low / default |

## 5. Typography (Inter; matches current repo --font-sans)

| Token | Size / Line / Weight | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| text/display | 28 / 34 / 700 | Page title ("Dashboard Overview") |
| text/h1      | 22 / 28 / 700 | Section / step title ("Step 1: When?") |
| text/h2      | 18 / 24 / 600 | Card titles |
| text/body    | 16 / 24 / 400 | Default body (Ã¢â€°Â¥16 for low-tech users) |
| text/bodyMed | 16 / 24 / 600 | Emphasis / tile labels |
| text/small   | 14 / 20 / 400 | Secondary |
| text/caption | 12 / 16 / 500 | Badges, timestamps, counts |
| text/kpi     | 32 / 38 / 700 | KPI numbers ("156", "94.2%") |

Min base size is 16px on purpose (Atria's "really bad with technology" users).

## 6. Spacing (4pt base)

| Token | px |  | Token | px |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| space/1 | 4  | | space/5 | 24 |
| space/2 | 8  | | space/6 | 32 |
| space/3 | 12 | | space/8 | 48 |
| space/4 | 16 | | space/10 | 64 |

Default card padding = space/5 (24). Page gutters = space/6 (32) desktop, space/4 mobile.

## 7. Radius

| Token | px | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| radius/sm  | 8  | Inputs, badges |
| radius/md  | 12 | Buttons |
| radius/lg  | 16 | Cards, tiles |
| radius/xl  | 20 | Wizard step panels |
| radius/pill | 999 | Pill buttons, progress bar |

## 8. Sizing / touch targets

| Token | px | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| size/control/md | 40 | Standard input/button height |
| size/control/lg | 52 | Primary wizard buttons / mobile (Ã¢â€°Â¥44 min) |
| size/tile       | 88 | Service/Goal tap tiles (big touch target) |
| size/sidebar    | 248 | Left nav width (desktop) |
| size/topbar     | 64 | Top bar height |
| size/kpiCard    | 140 | KPI card min height |
| size/avatar     | 36 | List avatars |

## 9. Elevation / effects
- shadow/card: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)
- shadow/pop: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)
- focus ring: 2px color/accent/primary at 60% + 2px offset
- Selected tile: 1.5px color/accent/primary border + color/accent/primaryQuiet fill + check icon.

## 10. Component inventory (built from the tokens above)
Button (variants: primary, secondary, ghost, danger; sizes md, lg) Ã‚Â· IconButton Ã‚Â·
Card / CardHeader / CardTitle / CardContent Ã‚Â· KpiCard (label, value, deltaÃ‚Â±, icon) Ã‚Â·
StatusPill (success/warning/danger/info/neutral) Ã‚Â· CountBadge Ã‚Â· Input Ã‚Â· Select Ã‚Â· Textarea
(+ char count + inline "Looking good!" validation row) Ã‚Â· FieldGroup (label + helper + error)
Ã‚Â· Checkbox Ã‚Â· RadioCard (the "No, everything was fine" big option rows) Ã‚Â· Tabs Ã‚Â· Table Ã‚Â·
Dialog Ã‚Â· Toast Ã‚Â· Avatar Ã‚Â· ProgressBar (top of wizard) Ã‚Â· StepRail + StepChip (emoji/icon,
active/complete/upcoming) Ã‚Â· BottomProgressTracker Ã‚Â· ServiceTile / GoalTile (emoji + label,
selectable) Ã‚Â· AlertRow (icon, title, "Action Required" pill, timestamp) Ã‚Â· ComplianceRow
(avatar, name, status pill, progress, x/8) Ã‚Â· CategoryBar (label, count, % bar) Ã‚Â· Sidebar +
NavItem (icon, label, count badge, section header) Ã‚Â· Topbar (search, Quick Actions,
notifications, env pill, user) Ã‚Â· EmptyState Ã‚Â· LoadingState Ã‚Â· ErrorState Ã‚Â· PermissionDenied.

## 11. Light mode (later)
When we add Light: keep every token name, add a "Light" mode to the ATRIA collection.
Likely values reuse the current repo's light palette (bg #f4f7f8, surface #fff, ink
#17212b, accent #0f766e, borders #d9e3e7). Status/step accents stay the same hues, darkened
for contrast on light. No component rework needed Ã¢â‚¬â€ only the mode values change.

  --color-atria-bg: #f4f7f8;
  --color-atria-surface: #ffffff;

  --color-atria-accent-hover: #115e59;
  --color-atria-success: #16834f;

  --color-atria-danger: #b42318;
